brief:
Nicolay Mladenov, the UN envoy for the Middle East peace process, warned that the Gaza ceasefire faces serious risk of breakdown, Al Jazeera reported. In an interview with the outlet, Mladenov cautioned that a return to war would prove "devastating" for the territory and its civilians.

The warning comes as international mediators work to shore up the truce agreement. Mladenov did not specify which factors pose the greatest threat to the ceasefire's stability, but his comments reflect broader diplomatic anxiety about the arrangement's durability amid ongoing tensions and competing demands from parties to the conflict.
dek: In an interview with Al Jazeera, Nicolay Mladenov says that a return to war would be 'devastating'.
title: UN envoy warns Gaza ceasefire risks collapse
